info.name: Reseller API V1.2
info.description:
## Overview

Cosmotown provides you with an API to manage your domains and perform certain actions in your account. The API can be used by anyone who wants to manage their domains and account or create their own experience for registering, purchasing, and managing domains.

Functionality is currently limited but as more functionality is added it will be documented here.

## **Authentication**

You will need an **API Key** to authenticate and authorize your requests. All API calls must include valid API keys. You can generate your API key from cosmotown admin screen.

Cosmotown provides production as well as test server environment.  
Test Server Environment is called [Sandbox](https://sandbox.cosmotown.com/). Please [signup in sandbox](https://sandbox.cosmotown.com/), enable API access and test all your API calls on the sandbox environment before pointing your application to production. To point an application to production, you need make only minor changes. In most cases, you simply need to change the `URL` and `APIkey`.

When you are ready for production, create a new API Key and Secret to call our [Production](https://cosmotown.com/) environment

## Error Codes

200: Successful  
400: Unsuccessful Request. See the error_message paramter for more details  
403: Unauthorized. API key is invalid or IP is not whitelisted.  
500: Server Side Error
